text: [16] dasayime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa katame dasa tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho paccekasambuddho ubhatobhāgavimutto paññāvimutto kāyasakkhi diṭṭhippatto saddhāvimutto dhammānusārī saddhānusārī gotrabhū ime kho bhikkhave dasa puggalā āhuneyyā .pe. anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti .
